title: Performance Video Editor for Winning Meta Ads
description:
We’re looking for a highly skilled Performance Video Editor to help us iterate on winning Meta video ads.



This is not a role focused on creating brand films or editing generic social content. Your main job is to take proven winning ad concepts and turn them into high-quality variations that improve engagement, retention, clarity, and freshness, without damaging what made the ad work in the first place.



You will work with existing winning creatives that we hand to you. We will usually provide the strategic direction, testing hypothesis, new hooks when relevant, and structured feedback. We are looking for someone who can execute at a high level, collaborate well, and bring strong performance-editing instincts to the table.



What you’ll do

- Create variations of existing winning Meta video ads

- Improve pacing, tighten edits, and shorten videos where needed

- Add VFX, sound effects, motion emphasis, and visual polish to key moments

- Add and refine subtitles, captions, text overlays, and on-screen hierarchy

- Integrate B-roll and additional voice-over when provided

- Clean up audio and improve overall sound quality

- Clean up cuts and make edits feel sharper and more intentional

- Deliver polished, finished 9:16 exports optimized for Meta paid social

- Revise quickly and accurately based on structured feedback

- Occasionally suggest smart edit improvements beyond the brief, with reasoning



What this role is focused on

This role is about iterating on winners, not reinventing them.



We want someone who understands how to:

- preserve the winning core of an ad

- create controlled variations tied to a specific testing hypothesis

- improve engagement in different ways through editing

- make key moments land harder without overediting

- balance direct-response performance with high production quality



What we’ll provide

- The winning concept to iterate on

- A clear brief and testing hypothesis for each variation

- New hooks when needed

- Ideas for moments to emphasize

- Additional VO, B-roll direction, or text direction when relevant

- Structured feedback for revisions

- Our Brand Book with brand direction



What we need from you

- Strong experience editing performance creative / direct-response ads

- Strong understanding of Meta paid social

- Excellent pacing and retention instincts

- Advanced editing skills beyond basic raw UGC cutting

- Strong subtitle and text-overlay design sense

- Strong VFX / SFX / motion enhancement instincts

- Clean audio editing and finishing ability

- Ability to follow a brief while also contributing thoughtful ideas

- Strong organization, file hygiene, and version control

- Ability to deliver finished work at a consistently high standard



Important constraints

- The first 3 seconds are generally off-limits in terms of changing the underlying footage

- Effects, polish, and editing improvements can be added, but the core opening footage usually stays

- These are hypothesis-driven variations, not random creative remixes

- Revisions are part of the process and should not be an issue

- Deliverables must be high quality, with Meta-optimized resolutions and exports



Ideal profile

You’re likely a strong fit if you:

- have edited for DTC brands or performance agencies

- understand retention, payoff, proof, pacing, and direct-response structure

- know how to make ads feel fresher without changing the core concept too much

- can collaborate with founders / marketers and improve execution quality

- understand that every edit should serve performance, not just aesthetics



Nice to have

- Experience with supplement, wellness, health, or consumer product brands

- Ability to work in Premiere Pro and After Effects

- Ability to source or create tasteful supporting motion / visual enhancement where needed

- Familiarity with version testing workflows



Working setup

- Freelance to start

- Potential for regular ongoing work / retainer if the fit is strong

- Work will be assigned on a concept-by-concept basis around winning ads we want to scale or refresh



To apply

Please send:

- a short introduction

- relevant examples of performance / direct-response ad edits

- examples where you created variations of an existing winning concept

- the software you use

- your typical turnaround times

- your rate structure

- whether you are open to a paid trial task



When applying, include the phrase: “controlled variation beats random editing” so we know you read the full brief.

title: Expert Media Buyer - Google Ads & Meta Ads : 400 - 800 USD/mo
description:
OVERVIEW



RMD is a digital agency with clients in 20+ countries. We're hiring a Media Buyer to own paid acquisition on Google Ads and Meta Ads, from setup to the part most people skip: making the campaigns actually work.



This is not a "launch it and check back next week" seat. We need someone who treats every account like their own money is in it. You build the campaign, yes, but more importantly you read the numbers every day, find what's leaking, and fix it before the client has to ask.



This is also not a junior seat where we hold your hand. We want someone ahead of us on paid media. Someone who teaches the team, raises the standard, and keeps learning every single day on their own. If you're the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when a campaign is spending without a clear answer on why it's converting (or why it isn't), this is for you.



Compensation: $400 to $800 USD per month based on experience and proven results, paid via PayPal. Top performers move up fast. See the pay-growth section below.



Hours: 40 hours per week, Manila time. We need 4 hours of overlap with Morocco/Dubai (so a 1pm to 9pm or 2pm to 10pm Manila shift is ideal).



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Plan, build, and launch Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen) and Meta Ads (Advantage+, traffic/conversion campaigns) from a brief, with clean account structure, correct conversion goals, and sane budgets

- Create clear, detailed briefs for ad creatives — concept, angle, hook, format, copy direction, and reference — so designers and video editors can execute without guessing

- Strategize for clients, not just execute. Own the account-level plan: funnel structure, offer/angle testing roadmap, budget allocation across channels, and where to scale next

- Run benchmarks. Pull and track performance against industry and account baselines (CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM, CVR) so every result has a "good vs. bad" reference, not a number in a vacuum

- Own performance daily. Watch spend, CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate, and frequency. Catch problems within hours, not at month-end

- Run campaigns in multiple languages. Our clients span Morocco, Dubai, France, and beyond. You use AI and translation tools to localize ad copy, keywords, and audiences quickly and correctly, then sanity-check the output before it goes live

- Set up and verify tracking properly: Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4 events, consent mode v2, and confirm the data is actually firing and matching, not "the pixel is green, ship it"

- Run weekly account-health checks: disapproved ads, broken conversion tracking, audience overlap, budget pacing, wasted spend on junk placements and search terms. Flag what you find with a recommendation, not just a list

- Write the analysis. Every report answers: what happened, why, what you're doing about it, what you need from us. No vanity metrics. We don't care about impressions and "engagement" if the leads or sales aren't moving

- Build and follow repeatable processes: launch checklists, naming conventions, weekly optimization routines, reporting templates. If you do something twice, it should become a documented process

- Run structured tests: creative tests, audience tests, bid strategy tests, landing page angle tests. One variable, clear hypothesis, real read on the result

- Manage budgets responsibly and scale what works without torching CPA

- Teach the team. Share what you know, document your playbooks, and level up the people around you

- Communicate async, in writing, with the numbers attached



WHAT YOU NEED ON DAY ONE



The floor on this role is real. You walk in with these or you don't walk in.



- 2+ years managing live Google Ads AND Meta Ads accounts. Not a course, not a sandbox. Real accounts with real spend that you were responsible for and held accountable for

- You are genuinely analytical and great with numbers. You can look at a performance table and immediately see where the money is going wrong. CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPM, frequency, AOV are not jargon to you, they're the tools you think with

- You can write ad creative briefs and set creative direction. You know what makes a hook stop the scroll and can brief a designer or editor so they execute without guessing

- You think strategy, not just execution. You can build an account-level plan: funnel, offers/angles to test, budget split across channels, and a clear point of view on where to scale

- Pixel and conversion tracking setup. Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google Ads conversion tags, GA4. You've installed them, debugged them, and confirmed events fire correctly (Events Manager, Tag Assistant, GA4 DebugView)

- Consent Mode v2 experience. You understand why it matters for EU tracking and have implemented or worked with it

- You create and follow processes. You don't rely on memory. You build checklists and routines and you stick to them

- You run ads in multiple languages. You're comfortable using AI and translation tools to localize campaigns for different markets, and you know how to check that the localized copy is actually good and not robotic

- Recent performance screenshots are a MUST. Send real, recent (last 6 months) screenshots from Ads Manager, Google Ads, or GA4 showing accounts you managed: spend, CPA/ROAS, results over time. Redacted client names are fine. No screenshots, no shortlist

- Killer analysis, not vanity metrics. When you send those screenshots, tell us the story: what was broken, what you changed, what happened. "We lowered CPA from $42 to $19 by cutting X and restructuring Y" beats "we got 2M impressions"

- You care about client results like an owner. You're not satisfied when the campaign is "running." You're satisfied when it's winning. People who set up campaigns and walk away are not who we want

- You self-train every day. Paid media changes constantly. Platforms ship updates, policies shift, what worked last quarter dies. We expect you to do your own daily learning to stay ahead, not wait for us to teach you. You should be the one bringing new tactics to the table

- You read English well. Our briefs and reports are in English

- Honesty about what you don't know. "I haven't run PMax much, but I've run a lot of Search and I learn fast" beats "yes I know everything" followed by a blown budget



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED, BUT MOVES YOU UP THE LIST)



- An account where you can show a clear before/after: CPA down, ROAS up, or scale without losing efficiency, with the GA4/Ads Manager screenshots to prove it

- Experience scaling an account past $10K/month in spend profitably

- E-commerce / Shopify paid media (we have e-commerce clients)

- Lead-gen experience with offline/CRM conversion tracking

- Server-side tracking (sGTM, CAPI Gateway) experience

- Google Tag Manager fluency

- French (we have clients in France and North Africa)

- Comfortable recording Loom walkthroughs of an account to explain your thinking async



WHO WE ARE



A small team distributed across Morocco and Dubai. We work in writing, async-first, and we trust people to ship and to own the number.



We use AI in the daily work, in media buying, in copy, and in translation. We expect you to use it too, fluently, after onboarding. The test for this role does not allow AI, because we need to see how YOU read an account and make decisions.



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT (read this part carefully)



This is a seat with a high ceiling for someone who is already strong and keeps getting stronger. Here's what that means:



- You will get to do more, fast. If you can build clean campaigns and actually move the numbers, we hand you more accounts, bigger budgets, and a real say in strategy. We don't make good media buyers babysit one account forever.

- We reward results. Drop a CPA, scale a winning account, save a campaign we thought was dead, and we adjust your pay and scope to match. We don't make people wait 2 years for a real raise. A-players see significant pay growth (50% to 80%+) inside the first year.

- You set the standard, and we back it. We want someone who pushes us forward on paid media, brings us new tactics, and teaches the team. If you do that, you get more ownership, not more oversight.

- The ceiling is what you make of it. Our best media buyers grow into account strategists and paid media leads who own client relationships and budgets. You d
 how fast.



Who this is NOT for: people who set up a campaign, send a screenshot of impressions, and call it a day. People who get nervous reading a numbers table. People who wait to be taught instead of teaching themselves. If comfortable, low-pressure, and no growth is the goal, this isn't the seat. Apply somewhere else, no hard feelings.



HOW TO APPLY



- Reply with your CV

- Include recent performance screenshots (last 6 months) from accounts you've managed: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and/or GA4. Show spend and results over time. Redacted client/brand names are fine. This is required, not optional

- Start your
 body with the line: RMD RMD. (Yes, exactly those two words on the first line. This is how we know you actually read the post.)

- In the
, confirm you read this full brief and confirm the exact monthly pay you're looking for (in USD). Be specific, not a range

- Tell us in 2 to 3 sentences: what's the most recent account you managed? What was broken or underperforming, what did you change, and what was the measurable result?

- If your application makes our shortlist, we send you a free 45-minute practical test (we'll show you the scoring before you start). Expect to read a real account's numbers and tell us what you'd do

- We reply within 5 business days if we want to move you forward. We're a small team with no dedicated recruiter. If you don't hear from us in that window, it wasn't a fit this round. Don't take it personally and please don't chase. We respect your time enough to be honest about that.



WHAT NOT TO SEND



- A CV with no performance screenshots

- Vanity metrics (impressions, reach, "engagement") with no link to leads or sales

- "I am hardworking and loyal" cover letters with no numbers

- Promises that you can do everything and scale anything (we know nobody can)



We're hiring one person for this role. We're patient. We will wait for the right fit.



Apply on OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 with subject "Media Buyer PH, [Your Full Name]"

title: Shopify Manager & Content
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Shopify Virtual Assistant to maintain, optimize, and polish our store on a weekly basis. This is a part-time role (5–10 hours per week) focused on content, design adjustments, and quality control — not heavy coding. Your mission is to keep the storefront clean, visually sharp, SEO-ready, and free of errors.



Core Responsibilities

 • Shopify Page Building & Maintenance

 • Create and update landing pages, product pages, and collection pages using Shopify’s theme editor.

 • Ensure layouts are responsive, visually aligned, and consistent with brand guidelines.

 • Update banners, menus, and other page elements as required.

 • Content Cleaning & Text Formatting

 • Sanitize product descriptions: correct grammar, fix formatting, ensure consistency in style and tone.

 • Upload, resize, and optimize product images.

 • Check for anomalies such as broken links, missing images, duplicate SKUs, or wrong prices.

 • SEO Optimization

 • Add and refine meta titles, descriptions, and keywords for products and collections.

 • Ensure all images have proper alt text.

 • Structure headings (H1, H2, etc.) correctly for readability and SEO impact.

 • Design & Graphics (Light)

 • Create or edit visuals for banners, product images, or social previews using Canva or Figma.

 • Ensure visuals are optimized for both desktop and mobile.

 • Maintain consistency in fonts, colors, and layouts across all pages.

 • Quality Assurance & Reporting

 • Perform a weekly QA sweep of the store to spot errors or inconsistencies.

 • Document fixes made and report any issues needing manager approval.

 • Keep records of updates in Google Drive.



Requirements

 • 2+ years of hands-on Shopify experience.

 • Strong eye for design and detail; ability to spot inconsistencies quickly.

 • Experience with Canva, Photoshop, or Figma for basic design tasks.

 • Familiarity with SEO basics (meta tags, alt text, heading structure).

 • Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive).

 • Strong written English for text editing and formatting.

 • Reliable, organized, and proactive — able to close tasks without constant supervision.



Conditions

 • Part-time: 5 hours per week.

 • Rate: depending on experience.



How to Apply

Send a short message about your Shopify experience, plus 2 examples of:

 1. A product/landing page you built or cleaned.

 2. A graphic/banner you designed (Canva/Figma/Photoshop).

As we continue to scale, we are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Financial Controller to lead our finance and accounting functions, strengthen financial processes, and provide strategic insights that drive business performance.



The Role



The Financial Controller will own the day-to-day financial operations of the business while serving as a strategic partner to leadership. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced eCommerce environment and has experience managing accounting, inventory finance, cash flow, and financial reporting.



You will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing working capital, supporting operational decision-making, and helping the company scale efficiently.



What You'll Do

Financial Reporting & Analysis



Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.

Prepare and review financial statements, including Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow reports.

Deliver accurate financial reporting and insights to the executive team.

Analyze business performance and identify opportunities to improve profitability and cash flow.



Accounting & Controls



Oversee all accounting functions, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, and reconciliations.

Maintain strong internal controls and accounting policies.

Ensure compliance with accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

Manage external audits and tax compliance activities.



Inventory & Supply Chain Finance

Oversee inventory accounting across Amazon FBA, 3PLs, warehouses, and wholesale channels.

Monitor inventory valuation, landed costs, freight expenses, and replenishment costs.

Partner with Supply Chain and Operations teams to improve inventory efficiency and working capital.



Budgeting & Forecasting

Lead annual budgeting and rolling forecasting processes.

Develop financial models to support strategic initiatives and growth plans.

Monitor performance against budget and provide variance analysis.



Cash Flow Management

Manage cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning.

Optimize working capital and support purchasing and inventory investment decisions.

Provide visibility into cash requirements and growth opportunities.



Systems & Process Improvement

Improve reporting accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.

description:
You're an experienced video editor who knows how to make Meta ads convert? Looking for volume, serious brands, and a setup that pushes you to deliver your best work? Read this.



We're LUMA. A creative video agency for e-commerce brands scaling on Meta Ads.



Our daily routine: 4 batches of 4 videos per day, deadline 7-8pm French time. 16 creatives produced, tested, iterated. No dead weeks, no "we'll let you know when there's work." Volume, all the time. The volume is totally manageable in a 7-8h workday, we have well-defined processes in place at the agency. BUT no need to worry about the volume, this covers both creation and iteration. We provide everything you need: b-rolls, tools, instructions, references, and full marketing documentation. 16 videos may sound like a lot, but we have a well-defined process that allows you to complete this volume within a standard 7–8 hour workday, and often less for more experienced editors.



We're looking for an experienced freelance video editor to join the team long-term, working on our English (USA & UK) brands.



Let's be clear: We're looking for someone who already knows how to edit, who has already worked on Meta ads, and who understands why a creative converts before opening their software.



For us, editing is 50% of the job. Marketing is the other 50%. You'll juggle multiple brands and multiple formats every day: UGC, mashup, VSL, short-form. Your ability to switch between universes without losing quality is what makes the difference.

And above all: you communicate and you propose.



We've worked with too many editors who deliver in silence, never ask a question, never bring an idea, and passively wait for the next brief. That doesn't work here. An editor who just executes, regardless of technical level, always ends up slowing us down.

What we expect daily



You communicate regularly on your progress, without us having to chase you. You ask the right questions when a brief is unclear, instead of guessing and missing the mark. You bring ideas: an alternative hook, a different angle, a variation that could perform better. You react fast to messages and feedback.

This is not optional. It's the baseline.



What we expect technically :



- Real experience editing ads (Premiere Pro, DaVinci… we don't care about the software, we care about the result).

- A real understanding of Meta paid social: what a hook is, why it stops a scroll, how a converting ad is structured.

- Speed AND quality, not one without the other. A portfolio that speaks for itself.



What awaits you if we sign :



- A regular and predictable workflow. No holes in your schedule.

- Concrete and demanding feedback that sharpens your creative eye.

- A rare variety of projects: you'll see in 3 months what other editors see in 2 years.

- Compensation matched to your level, scaling with your performance.

- 100% remote.

Your portfolio or 2-3 examples of ads you've edited

Your availability

title: Finance & Operations Assistant Reformly (E-Commerce & Mobile App)
description:
About Reformly

Reformly is a rapidly growing international e-commerce brand on a mission to help women become the best versions of themselves and feel confident in their bodies. We achieve this through our studio-quality, soft-minimalist Reformly Pilates Board bundled with our mobile app, offering guided workouts and a highly engaged community.



Operating on a high-performing recurring subscription model, we move fast. Founded in May 2025, we generated $4.3M in international sales in our first 12 months and currently have over 3,500 active subscriptions. We are a young, ambitious team, and we are looking for an A-player to help us scale our operations and optimize our profitability.





The Role: Mission

To take full ownership of Reformly’s financial administration and daily logistics, bringing impeccable accuracy, proactive communication, and structured execution to our processes in order to drive operational efficiency and profitability.





Tasks & Responsibilities

As our Finance & Operations Assistant, you will sit at the intersection of numbers and logistics. Your day-to-day will involve:

- Daily P&L Management: Keeping the daily Profit & Loss statements 100% up-to-date and accurate, with zero backlog.



- Invoice & Cost Auditing: Rigorously checking invoices and cost breakdowns to identify and resolve any discrepancies or errors.



- Data Entry & Calculations: Flawlessly inputting financial data and running ad-hoc cost calculations as needed.



- Order Fulfillment: Seamlessly managing daily order processing.



- Inventory Management: Maintaining an accurate, real-time inventory tracking sheet.



- Structured Reporting: Translating raw data into highly readable, organized updates for management.



- Proactive Issue Flagging: Immediately raising a red flag when processes slow down, numbers are off, or margins are at risk, and proactively bringing solutions.





Expected Outcomes (First 12 Months)

We measure success by results, not just hours worked. In your first year, you are expected to:

1. Drive Profitability: Actively audit cost breakdowns, check invoices for discrepancies, and identify operational efficiencies to help realize a gross margin increase from 70% to 73%.



2. Financial Precision: Maintain a 100?curate, up-to-date Daily P&L and cost calculation spreadsheet, ensuring all data entry is processed flawlessly with zero backlog at the end of each week.



3. Fulfillment & Inventory Mastery: Achieve and maintain an average order-to-delivery time of 12 days or less by taking full ownership of daily fulfillment operations. Guarantee zero stockouts through meticulous inventory tracking.





Who You Are (Competencies)

- Ownership & Autonomy: You do not need hand-holding or micro-management. You deeply understand the end goal and independently navigate the path to get there. You take full responsibility for outcomes, both successes and failures.



- High Standards & Attention to Detail: You are a healthy perfectionist. You inherently double-check work before submitting. You do not let small details, incorrect numbers, or minor logistical errors slip through the cracks.



- Analytical Rigor: You are highly comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets. You can quickly process financial and operational data, spot trends, calculate costs accurately, and draw logical conclusions without getting overwhelmed.



- Organization & Structured Planning: You plan, organize, and schedule tasks in a highly efficient and productive manner. You bring order to chaos and naturally create systems to keep daily operations running smoothly.



- Proactivity & Problem Solving: You act without being told what to do. You can think critically outside the standard operating procedures (SOPs) when exceptions occur. You bring solutions to the table, not just problems.





Our Core Values

We hire, reward, and fire based on our core values. Do not apply if you do not align with these:

- All-In Mentality (Impact Over Hours): We are not here just to collect a paycheck; we are here to achieve ambitious goals. You genuinely believe in what we are building and take deep pride in the results you deliver.



- Extreme Ownership (Radically Reliable): You understand that you are a crucial pillar of the team. When you take on a responsibility, the team can trust blindly that it will be executed flawlessly.



- Radical Candor (Direct & Transparent): No beating around the bush. We value efficient, clear, and straightforward communication. You are open, honest, and not afraid to give or receive direct feedback.



- High Velocity (Move Fast & Adapt): We are a young, fast-moving team. You thrive in a high-paced environment, pivot quickly when needed, and combine a sense of urgency with high execution power.



- Humble & Hungry (Continuous Growth): You bring positive energy. You are highly ambitious but leave your ego at the door. You are fiercely eager to learn, extremely coachable, and constantly looking to level up.





How to Apply

We do not want standard cover letters. To apply, please submit a Video Application covering the following:

1. A short introduction about yourself.



2. Why you are a perfect fit for this specific role and our core values.



3. A quick tour of your workspace (show us your desk/setup so we can see where the magic happens).

**Non-Negotiables**

**Tech Stack**



Required: GoHighLevel, Zapier, CRM Automation, Funnel Builds, Pipeline Management, Workflow Automations, Lead Attribution, UTM Tracking, Reporting Systems, Google Sheets



Strong Plus: Kajabi, Slack, Stripe, Meta Ads, AI workflow tools, API integrations



**Compensation**



Compensation is based on experience, execution ability, and ownership level. Project-based, retainer, and long-term opportunities are available for the right person. We care more about speed, ownership, execution, and results than resumes.



**How to Apply**



Please submit one concise example from a GoHighLevel system or automation build you personally created. You may use a previous client project or a redacted sample with private information removed.



We specifically want to see how one lead moves from:



first click or DM ? booked opportunity ? closed revenue

 lead” or “Instagram lead” does not meet the standard for this role.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
We are MSTR, an AI software company based in the Netherlands. We build custom AI-driven applications that help businesses work smarter and more intelligently, from first conversation to production-ready product.



Our team has around 17 people: a customer-facing team of 6 here in the Netherlands, and 11 developers based in the Philippines. All of our sales currently happen in the Netherlands. We're expanding internationally, and we need someone to help us open those doors.



What this role is:

You'll be the engine behind MSTR's international growth. Your job is simple to describe and hard to do well: pick up the phone, have real conversations with decision-makers in the US, UK, and Europe, and book qualified meetings for our Netherlands-based sales team. They handle the closing (for now).



This is not a call center role and not a scripted pitch. You will represent a premium AI consultancy in front of CTOs, Heads of Engineering, and Product Leaders. We provide a curated lead list, full product training, and the tools you need to work efficiently.



What you'll actually be doing:

- High-volume outbound cold calling to decision-makers at target companies

- Qualifying prospects based on fit, interest, and alignment with our offerings

- Booking qualified meetings directly into the calendars of our Dutch sales team

- Supporting outreach through LinkedIn engagement and messaging

- Assisting our Head of Sales with outreach materials and lead research

- Reporting weekly on activity, pipeline, and insights from conversations



What you'll be selling:

- Work-with-AI program (3 to 5 weeks): we identify AI opportunities inside a company, deliver a prioritized roadmap and start building these out in an AI Operating System we set up for the client. 

- Deep Dive (3 to 5 weeks): the full technical blueprint of an AI solution, ready for development.

- AI Development training (3 to 5 weeks): hands-on training for development teams of 5 to 100 developers on how to build with AI.



Average deal size is €10,000 to €20,000. Target companies sit between 20 and 500 employees in sectors like construction, real estate, software/SaaS, finance/legal, and HR/payroll.



Who we're looking for:

Someone with 3+ years of B2B outbound sales experience and a strong track record of cold calling, especially into international markets. Fluent English, confident on the phone, and comfortable speaking with C-level executives and senior technical decision-makers. You're a self-starter who can manage your own pipeline without constant oversight, and you get more energy out of a conversation than you put in.



Familiarity with tools like Attio, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and VoIP dialers is expected. Experience selling tech, SaaS, or AI-related services is a strong plus. Bonus points if you've already played with tools like Claude, Claude Code, or n8n yourself.



Work setup:

- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, US business hours (evening/night shift Philippine time)

- Reporting to the Head of Sales at MSTR



How to apply:

We assess candidates through a short video introduction rather than long application forms. Send us a 3 to 7 minute video answering:

1. A brief intro about yourself and what drives you

2. Walk us through your most memorable cold call or meeting you booked. What made it work?

3. Why working at an AI company right now excites you

4. How you handle rejection and stay disciplined on your own pipeline

5. What you're looking for in your next role and where you see yourself long-term



No polish needed. We're looking for clarity, energy, and authenticity. Please don't read from a script.



Upload your video to Google Drive, Dropbox, or YouTube (unlisted) and share the link. Include your CV or LinkedIn. Please send everything to nigel@mstr.nl. We are happy to answer any questions.



We are looking forward to hearing from you.

- Experience editing short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube Shorts

- Strong understanding of pacing and retention - you know what makes someone watch to the end vs. swipe away

- Ability to match B-roll to dialogue and keep the energy up throughout

- Proficient with Premiere Pro & has experience editing 360 footage from an Insta360 camera

- Great attention to detail and reliability

s, voi

title: Appointment Setter
description:
We are seeking a confident, personable, and highly reliable Appointment Setter to manage inbound calls and warm leads generated through paid advertising. This is a full-time, client-facing role that combines the precision of a sales qualifier with the professionalism of a front-desk receptionist.

The ideal candidate answers calls promptly, engages prospects with warmth and clarity, qualifies leads against defined criteria, and books appointments with a high conversion rate. ---

• Book appointments accurately within the scheduling system and confirm details with each prospect

• Follow up with leads who did not book on the first call to re-engage and convert

• Meet and maintain a strong appointment conversion rate as a key performance benchmark



**CRM Management & Lead Tracking**

• Work within GrowHub 360 (Go High Level) to manage, update, and track all inbound leads

• Log call outcomes, lead status, and appointment details accurately after every interaction

• Ensure no leads fall through the cracks by maintaining an organized and up-to-date pipeline

• Flag unresponsive or unqualified leads appropriately within the CRM for review

• Pull basic reports or updates on lead activity and appointment volume as requested



**Client Communication & Follow-Up**

• Send appointment confirmations and reminders to booked clients ahead of scheduled dates

• Conduct follow-up calls or messages for no-shows and rescheduling requests

• Respond to general inquiries and direct clients to the appropriate tea
mber when needed

• Maintain clear and professional communication throughout the entire client experience

• Support a smooth handoff from the appointment setting stage to the service delivery team



---



## Requirements



**Essential Skills**

•Excellent verbal communication skills with a warm, clear, and confident phone presence

•Proven ability to qualify leads and convert inbound inquiries into booked appointments

• Strong time management and the ability to handle high call volumes without sacrificing quality

• Reliable, punctual, and fully committed to the full-time schedule and shift hours

• Self-motivated with the ability to stay focused and productive throughout long shift windows

Technical Skills

• Experience with CRM platforms, preferably Go High Level or similar tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)

• Comfortable navigating lead pipelines, updating contact records, and booking appointments within a CRM

• Proficiency in standard communication tools including phone systems,
, and messaging platforms

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: AU Credit Analyst
description:
Experience in AU Lender Mortgage side is needed for this role.



Job Brief  



We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Credit Analyst to support our lenders in managing the end-to-end mortgage application process. This role requires a professional with a minimum of 3 to 4 years of specific Australian mortgage and lending experience; as such, we are looking for a candidate who can hit the ground running without the need for foundational training. You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of a loan, from lead conversion and data entry to credit assessment and post-settlement enquiries. While you will receive initial support, you are expected to take full ownership of your workflow, ensuring all applications meet rigorous credit policies and legislative standards. 



Responsibilities 

Salesforce & LoanApp Management: Managing accurate data entry within Salesforce and overseeing the LoanApp platform to ensure seamless application flows. 

Lead Conversion: Creating leads and converting them into opportunities within the CRM system. 

Application Submission: Submitting completed loan applications to the funder and issuing credit guides where applicable. 

Valuation Management: Ordering and managing valuation reports to ensure property security meets lending criteria. 

Reporting & Title Searches: Generating comprehensive credit reports and completing necessary title searches. 

Progress Draw Management: Overseeing the management of progress draws for construction or staged funding. 

KYC Compliance: Completing Know Your Customer (KYC) verifications using tools such as IDyou or IDkit. 

Documentation & Signatures: Completing all required application forms and coordinating the sending of documents for digital signatures. 

Financial Calculations: Completing funding tables and servicing calculators to determine borrower capacity. 

Credit Proposal Drafting: Drafting detailed credit proposals for formal credit assessment. 

Credit Assessment: Assessing applications prior to submission to the senior credit analyst for final review. 

Policy Compliance: Reviewing credit limits in line with specific internal policies and procedures.

Approval Recommendations: Recommending applications for approval or decline based on risk analysis. 

Underwriter Liaison: Dealing with underwriter Mortgage Information Requests (MIR) and resolving technical queries. 

Outcome Notification: Issuing formal approval or decline letters to relevant parties. 

Settlement Support: Assisting with a wide range of pre-settlement and post-settlement enquiries. 



Requirements 

3–4 years of direct experience in Australian mortgage lending (lender-side experience is essential; broker-side only will not be considered). 

Proven ability to handle the end-to-end loan process with minimal supervision. 

Deep understanding of Australian credit policies and lending benchmarks. 

Advanced analytical, mathematical, and comprehension skills. 

Ability to manage competing deadlines effectively in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment. 

Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies in complex financial data. 

Strong communication skills for interacting with underwriters and internal stakeholders. 



Software Proficiency 

Salesforce (nice to have) 

LoanApp 

IDyou / IDkit 

Credit Reporting Tools (Equifax / Illion) 

Servicing Calculators 

Microsoft Office Suite 



Education 

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or other business-related fields. 

Additional certifications in Australian Mortgage Broking or Financial Services are highly desirable. 



Personal Attributes 

Critical thinking – Ability to evaluate applications objectively and identify potential risks. 

Consistent and methodical – A disciplined approach to following processes and procedures. 

Persistence – Dedication to seeing complex applications through to completion and resolving MIRs. 

Team orientated – A collaborative mindset focused on supporting lenders and the wider credit team. 

Love of learning – A desire to stay updated on evolving Australian lending regulations and policies. 



Time Zone: Australian Business Hours 



Applicant Location: Must be located in the Philippines

This is a long-term opportunity to work with a well-established VoIP provider that’s building a modern, AI-enhanced solution from the ground up using open-source tools.



You’ll work on everything from the CRM frontend to embedded WebRTC softphone to integrating AI tools that make calls smarter and more insightful.

Develop a custom CRM using React (or Next.js) and Node.js or Python



Embed a browser-based VoIP softphone using JsSIP or SIP.js



Create AI-powered features including:



Call transcription with Whisper (local or API)



Sentiment analysis using LLMs or Hugging Face models



Natural-language call summaries (OpenAI, Claude, or Mixtral via API)



Document-based IVR using LangChain or LlamaIndex (RAG pipelines)





Design clean user dashboards for call logs, summaries, QA monitoring, and analytics



Structure scalable backend services with PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker



Optionally assist with DevOps and deployment pipelines (Portainer, Watchtower, CI)







---



AI Tech Stack You Should Know or Be Willing to Learn:



LLMs: OpenAI (GPT-4), Claude, or open models via Hugging Face



STT: Whisper, Deepgram, or Coqui STT



NLP: LangChain, LlamaIndex, sentence-transformers



Vector Databases: ChromaDB, Pinecone, Weaviate



RAG Pipelines: Chunking, embedding, and search-based Q&A







---



Preferred Qualifications:



Strong full-stack experience (React/Next.js + Node.js or Python)



Experience with VoIP (Asterisk, FreePBX, or Kazoo/2600Hz)



Familiar with WebRTC, SIP.js or JsSIP



Comfortable with Dockerized environments



Past work on AI/ML/NLP projects, chatbots, or speech interfaces



Bonus: Familiarity with multi-tenant app architecture







---



Job Details:



Full-time or part-time (30–40 hrs/week)



Fully remote / work-from-home



Long-term contract with opportunity for growth



Monthly salary in PHP (based on experience)



Performance-based bonuses







---



How to Apply:



Please include:



Resume / CV



GitHub or code samples (especially AI, VoIP, or CRM-related)



Short message explaining your experience with LLMs, Whisper, or VoIP



Your expected monthly salary in USD

title: 3D Modeler for Multi-Part, Print-Ready Pop Culture Decor (Marvel/Star Wars Inspired)
description:
Do you create 3D models designed for real-world 3D printing? Do you geek out over Star Wars, Marvel, cosplay armor, or wall decor that looks like it belongs in a man cave or themed room?



We’re looking for a full-time 3D modeler to join our growing brand. You’ll be helping us create stunning, multi-part 3D printable models for Patreon—designed specifically for FDM printers and home hobbyists.



These models are split into parts so they can be printed in individual filament colors and snapped or glued together—no painting required.





---



Examples of What You’ll Help Build:



A superhero bust breaking through a wall (hangable decor)



Pop culture helmets split by detail and color



Props or masks designed to be modular and display-ready



Creative themed designs that fit in a kids' room, office, or collector shelf







---



What You’ll Do:



Design clean, multi-part 3D printable models for FDM printers



Ensure models are split by color group (each color = separate file)



Add pegs, joints, and simple assembly features



Keep designs support-free or low-support



Deliver organized folders with labeled STL files



Provide basic preview renders and exploded layout if needed







---



Monthly Output Expectations:



You’ll be expected to produce 4–6 models per month, based on size and complexity:



1–2 large centerpiece models (wall busts, helmets, or props)



1–2 medium models (small helmets, creatures, masks, etc.)



1–2 small models or extras (mini decor pieces, accessories, bonus files)





Some may be simpler, some more intricate—but your job is to keep a consistent pace and maintain quality and creativity.





---



Software You Should Be Proficient With:



Blender, ZBrush, Fusion 360, or equivalent



Meshmixer / Netfabb (for slicing, repairing, and splitting parts)



Optional: slicers like PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, or Cura (to visualize your output)







---



Bonus Skills:



Familiar with cosplay, props, or display art



Understanding of tolerances and snap-fit mechanics



Capable of checking STL output for printability



Can do simple presentation renders







---



Pay & Schedule:



$1,300/month USD



Full-time, 40 hours/week expected



Long-term position with potential for bonuses, growth, and community recognition



Paid weekly (during onboarding), then biweekly/monthly



Must be self-motivated and communicative—this is a collaborative creative position







---



How to Apply:



To help us find the right fit, please include the following:



1. Start your message with the word: Modular





2. Send 2–3 examples of your own 3D printable models (bonus if multi-part or colored)





3. List what software you use and your typical workflow





4. Give us 1 creative wall decor or helmet idea you think would make an awesome print





5. Share your average time to complete a full model









---



We’re building something fun, fan-focused, and print-friendly—and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us. If you live for clean meshes, cool designs, and geeking out over prints—let’s talk.

JOB OVERVIEW

-Organic community outreach and messaging across social platforms

-Flag trending content and 
nts in the pickleball world to capitalize on

-Report weekly on what's working, what's not, and what to try next



DESCRIPTION OF IDEAL CANDIDATE

Young and Social Media Native

You grew up on TikTok and Instagram. You understand how content moves, what makes people stop scrolling, and how communities actually talk to each other. You don't need to be told what's trending — you already know.



AI-Fluent, Not AI-Dependent

You know how to use AI tools to work faster and smarter — whether that's for research, scheduling, automation, or ideation. But you also know the difference between content that feels human and content that screams "AI wrote this." We have zero tolerance for AI slop. If you use AI, it's a tool, not a ghostwriter.



Gets Stuff Done

You take charge and make things happen. You don't make excuses. You have an internal drive to grow something and you'll do whatever it takes.



Self Starter

You're self-motivated and happy working independently. You don't sit around waiting to be told what to do next.



Creative

You have an eye for what will resonate with an audience. You know the difference between content that flops and content that hits — and you're always thinking about how to make the next post better than the last.



Solves Problems

When something isn't working, you figure out why and try something different. You don't wait to be told.



Takes Ownership

You love having responsibility. You want to be the person who makes something succeed.



Growth-Minded

You're always learning. You stay on top of platform changes, new tools, and what's working in the social media space right now.



You Do What You Say

If you commit to something, you follow through. Simple as that.



COMPANY CULTURE

We're direct and transparent. We work hard, move fast, and have fun doing it. You'll work closely with the founder — communication is open and feedback is immediate. If something isn't working, we talk about it and fix it.



PAY

200–250 PHP per hour, based on ability and experience. Part-time (~10 hours/week) to start, with a direct path to full-time based on results. If you believe you have more to offer, tell us what you'd like and why.



CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

-Honest and reliable

-Strong written English — natural, conversational tone

-Actively uses TikTok, Instagram, and Reddit personally (not just professionally)

-Comfortable with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automation platforms, etc.) — but creates original, human-feeling content

-Own computer with reliable internet connection

-Comfortable with video calls during late US Pacific Time hours



Working Hours

Part-time (~10 hours/week). Preferred overlap with late US Pacific Time (evenings PST / mornings PHT).



HOW TO APPLY

Message a short cover letter + resume as a response to this job post.



To apply, start your cover letter and your onlinejobs.ph message response header with: "Pickleball Ready"



Also please send a short video (2 minutes max, Loom or YouTube link) introducing yourself and telling us: what's one piece of content you've seen recently that you thought was genius, and why? No templates — make it personal.



We look forward to working with you.

FULL STACK MOBILE DEVELOPER (React Native, Capacitor, iOS/Android, NestJS, AWS)





JOB OVERVIEW



We're building a mobile engagement platform built on the premise of gamification and rewards. Users complete real-world challenges, submit proof, earn points, and unlock rewards and recognition. Think Duolingo + Strava + ClassDojo.



Behind the mobile app is a full backend for creating challenges and rewards and managing content. The platform is multi-tenant: many organizations run on one system, each with its own challenges, rewards, members, and content, fully isolated from one another.



This is a long-term opportunity to help build the next version of a live platform that already has real users on both the Apple App Store and Google Play. The stack is modern and already locked in, the roadmap is clear, and you'll work directly with our existing development lead and CTO. You'll own real features end to end — from the database model, to the API, to the mobile app in users' hands.



A major near-term focus is a TikTok-style vertical video feed and a real-time AI feature, so video streaming and AI experience are a strong plus.





PLEASE NOTE



We are hiring an individual, not an agency or development firm. This is a full-time, exclusive position — we expect this to be your only job. Working with other clients at the same time is not allowed. Applications from agencies, teams, or anyone representing a company will not be considered.





RESPONSIBILITIES



• Build and ship the mobile app for both iOS (Apple App Store) and Android (Google Play) — React Native (Expo) for the next version, while also maintaining our current production app built with Capacitor during the transition



• Own the full mobile release process: builds, code signing, provisioning profiles, and store submissions and updates on App Store Connect and Google Play Console



• Develop the web admin dashboard (Next.js / React) where organizations create challenges and rewards and manage their content



• Build and maintain backend services in NestJS / Node.js on AWS (serverless + containers)



• Design and query a multi-tenant PostgreSQL (RDS) database — every record scoped per organization and fully isolated



• Build a vertical, TikTok-style video feed: smooth playback, preloading, and recycled players inside a virtualized list



• Set up and extend the video pipeline: S3 uploads, transcoding with AWS MediaConvert, adaptive bitrate (HLS) streaming, and delivery through CloudFront



• Integrate AI features using OpenAI and Anthropic (Claude) APIs, including RAG / vector search with pgvector



• Write clean, well-tested, well-commented production code, and keep work visible with frequent commits and clear updates





TECH STACK (you should know it or be willing to learn it)



• Mobile: React Native, Expo, Capacitor, iOS and Android app development, App Store Connect, Google Play Console



• Frontend / Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript



• Backend: NestJS, Node.js, REST APIs



• Cloud: AWS — Lambda / serverless, ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, MediaConvert



• Database: PostgreSQL, RDS, pgvector, multi-tenant data modeling



• Video: HLS / adaptive bitrate streaming, video transcoding, in-feed playback performance



• AI: OpenAI and Anthropic (Claude) APIs, RAG pipelines, vector search



• Tooling: Git / GitHub, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), Docker





PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Strong full-stack experience (React Native / Next.js + NestJS / Node.js, TypeScript throughout)



• Proven mobile app development for both iOS and Android — building, code signing, provisioning, and publishing to the Apple App Store and Google Play



• Familiarity with Capacitor (it powers our current production app during the transition to React Native)



• Real PostgreSQL depth — schema design, query performance, migrations, and multi-tenant data modeling



• Hands-on AWS experience (serverless, RDS, S3)



• Experience building video playback / streaming features (HLS, in-feed video, smooth performance on low-end Android)



• Past work with AI / LLM features — RAG, embeddings, streaming responses



• Bonus: native iOS (Swift) / Android (Kotlin) development and native module bridging (Swift / Kotlin to React Native) — useful for device-specific debugging and the path toward future camera / AR filter features



• Bonus: experience with multi-tenant application architecture



• Bonus: consumer or gamified product experience where engagement and retention matter





JOB DETAILS



• Full-time, 40 hrs/week — this is a full-time, exclusive role. We expect this to be your only job; working with other clients at the same time is not allowed.



• Individuals only — we are hiring a person, not an agency or development firm. Please do not apply if you represent a company or team.



• Fully remote / work-from-home



• Long-term contract with opportunity for growth



• Monthly salary in USD, based on experience







HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



• Resume / CV



• GitHub or code samples (especially mobile, video, or AI-related work)



• A short message about your experience shipping iOS and Android apps, video streaming, or LLM features



• Your expected monthly salary in USD

  • Reports To: Founder

  • Produce multiple cuts, formats, and aspect ratios from a single recording session to maximize output per shoot

  • Meet agreed turnaround times so editing never bottlenecks the publishing schedule

  • Incorporate viewer retention data and strategist feedback to continually refine pacing, hooks, and editing style

  • Build and maintain reusable editing templates, presets, and asset libraries to accelerate production

  • Re-cut and repurpose top-performing organic content into variations for paid ad campaigns

  • Document all editing workflows, templates, and standards to create repeatable systems that can eventually be deployed for 
 clients

  • Maintain open communication and attend syncs during the core 7 AM to 11 AM ET collaboration window to review feedback, align on briefs, and adjust output





RESULTS

  • Editing workflow and file pipeline mapped out and communication flow established with the Content Strategist (raw intake to edit to delivery)

  • Brand editing standards defined and applied consistently (captions, fonts, color, pacing, music)

  • First batches of edited short-form videos delivered and published on schedule

  • Baseline turnaround times and weekly output capacity established

By Day 60: Independent and Producing

  • Consistent editing cadence maintained across all designated channels without founder intervention

  • Reusable templates, presets, and asset libraries built and in active use

  • Multiple cuts and variations produced from each recording session to maximize output

  • Editing decisions informed by viewer retention metrics and strategist feedback

Beyond 90 Days: Scaling the Function

  • Editing systems packaged, refined, and ready to be deployed for 
 clients

  • Ad-variation production running smoothly to support paid campaigns based on proven organic winners

  • Proactive adoption of new editing techniques, formats, and platform shifts to keep the brand ahead of the curve

  • Acts as a trusted production partner to leadership on content quality and creative direction





REQUIREMENTS

  • 2-4 years in Video Editing, Content Production, or a similar creative production role

  • Well-rounded editor with a primary strength in short-form vertical video (IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, or TikTok) and comfort across other formats such as long-form and ads; strong portfolio or reel required

  • Expert in at least one professional editing suite (Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut Pro, Descript or other)

We’re a fast-growing social media agency producing high-performing short-form content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



This isn't just a job. As the agency grows, the team grows with it. More clients means more volume, higher bonuses, and bigger opportunities for the people who helped build it. We believe in rewarding the people who show up, execute well, and grow with us and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that from the ground floor.



We’re hiring a full-time AI Video Specialist to create raw AI clips and assemble them into polished short-form videos using our internal workflows.



This is an execution role. Not strategy.

You’ll be given clear briefs, proven systems, and step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOP's) for every task.



If you haven't used every tool on our stack yet, that's okay we'll teach the right person.



What You'll Do



Video Editing

- Turn raw footage into high-retention short-form content (Reels, TikToks, Shorts)

- Add captions, overlays, transitions, sound design, and B-roll in CapCut

- Follow brand guidelines and client briefs exactly

- Apply feedback quickly and accurately

- Deliver a consistent daily output, on time

- Maintain brand consistency across multiple client accounts



AI Clip Generation

- Generate AI video assets using tools like ChatGPT, Grok, and Veo3

- Execute SOPs precisely (prompts, settings, formats are predefined)

- Quality check all outputs (accuracy, artifacts, exports) before submission

- Flag issues and gaps to improve workflows

- Organize and label all assets clearly for handoff



General

- Manage multiple client projects without missing deadlines

- Keep files structured and easy to navigate

- Communicate proactively on progress, timelines, and blockers



Requirements



Must-Haves

- GROWTH MINDSET AND HUNGRY TO LEARN!!!!

- Strong proficiency in English (speaking, reading, writing)

- Experience editing short-form content - PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

- Experience prompting AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.)

- Strong proficiency in CapCut

- High attention to detail and quality

- Comfortable following SOPs (execute first, revise/polish second)

- Able to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Reliable internet and dedicated workspace

- Coachable, fast learner, and willing to adopt new tools

- Currently working with NO OTHER CLIENTS. All work commitment should be on this role.



Nice-to-Haves

- Agency or content production background

- Strong understanding of short-form performance (hooks, pacing, retention)

- Copywriting experience

- Strong WiFi



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Clear SOPs and briefs, no guesswork

- Training on AI tools for the right candidate

- Direct, respectful communication and fast feedback

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay (If you perform exceptionally well, we will add on top ANOTHER bonus)

- Access to required tools



How to Apply



Include all of the following. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED:

- Portfolio or reel (Drive, Notion, or direct links)

- 2–3 of your best short-form content edits (tiktoks, reels, yt shorts, etc.)

- Short answer (3–5 sentences): What do you do when an SOP is unclear?

- Your timezone + working hours



No portfolio = no review.

title: Book Keeper - online
description:
We are building something special across three separate ventures and we need someone equally special to own

our numbers completely. This is not a data-entry role — this is a strategic bookkeeping position where you will

take full ownership of the financial records for all three entities, ensure complete compliance with Australian tax

law, and give our leadership team the clarity and confidence to make bold decisions.



You will work remotely from the Philippines, coordinate daily with Beth, and report directly to Corey.

You will be the single source of financial truth across Reset Sanctuary, 4QTR & Experiences, and Walk With Me.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Full-Charge Bookkeeping — All Three Entities

– Maintain accurate, up-to-date books for all three organisations simultaneously

– Manage the chart of accounts, general ledger, and bank reconciliations for each entity

– Prepare accounts payable and accounts receivable across all businesses

– Record and categorise all income, expenses, and inter-entity transactions correctly

– Manage petty cash, credit card reconciliations, and supplier payments



2. Australian Tax Compliance

– Prepare and lodge Business Activity Statements (BAS) monthly/quarterly via the ATO Business Portal

– Ensure accurate GST reporting, claiming, and reconciliation across all entities

– Manage PAYG Withholding obligations — payroll tax reporting and remittance to the ATO

– Adhere to Single Touch Payroll (STP) Phase 2 requirements via the payroll system

– Maintain awareness of Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) obligations where applicable

– Support year-end tax preparation and liaise with the external accountant (Emandem) at EOFY

– Monitor ATO correspondence and ensure all lodgement deadlines are met without exception



3. Payroll Processing

– Process weekly/fortnightly payroll for all staff across Reset Sanctuary, 4QTR and Walk With Me

– Calculate and apply correct superannuation  to all eligible employees

– Manage leave accruals, termination payments, and entitlement tracking under the Fair Work Act

– Submit STP-compliant payroll data to the ATO via the approved payroll platform

– Maintain accurate employee records including TFN declarations and employment contracts



4. Not-for-Profit Bookkeeping — Walk With Me

– Maintain separate, compliant books for the not-for-profit entity

– Track restricted and unrestricted funds, grants, and donations with full acquittal records

– Prepare financial reports suitable for the Walk With Me board and any external reporting obligations

– Ensure compliance with ACNC governance and financial reporting standards where applicable

– Manage DGR-related records if Walk With Me holds Deductible Gift Recipient status



5. Financial Reporting

– Produce monthly Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow reports for each entity

– Deliver a consolidated financial summary to Corey by the 5th of each month

– Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility over revenue, expenses, and cash position

– Flag anomalies, unusual variances, or cashflow concerns proactively — don't wait to be asked



6. Software & Systems Management

– Own the bookkeeping platforms (Xero preferred) across all three entities

– Maintain integrations between Xero and payment systems, payroll platforms, and CRM where applicable

– Ensure digital records are organised, backed up, and audit-ready at all times

– Identify and implement efficiencies in financial workflows and reporting processes



REQUIRED AUSTRALIAN TAX & COMPLIANCE KNOWLEDGE



You must have working knowledge of the following. These are non-negotiable.

– Goods and Services Tax (GST) — 10% application, exemptions, BAS lodgement

– Business Activity Statements (BAS) — monthly and quarterly cycles, ATO portal lodgement

– Pay As You Go (PAYG) Withholding — calculation, reporting, and ATO remittance

– Single Touch Payroll (STP) Phase 2 — employer obligations and payroll platform compliance

– Superannuation Guarantee — current SG rate, Super Stream compliance, fund remittance

deadlines

– Australian Taxation Office (ATO) correspondence management and lodgement calendars

– Director Penalty Notices (DPN) — understanding of PAYG and SGC lockdown provisions

– Fair Work Act — leave entitlements, minimum wages, termination payment calculations

– Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) — basic awareness and flagging obligations

– Not-for-Profit tax obligations — income tax exemption requirements, ACNC, DGR records

– Australian Accounting Standards — accrual vs cash accounting principles

– Xero or equivalent cloud accounting platform — advanced user level



SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE



Essential

– Minimum 3 years experience in full-charge bookkeeping, preferably for multiple entities simultaneously

– Demonstrated experience working with Australian businesses and the Australian tax system

– Advanced Xero skills — certification strongly preferred

– Proven BAS preparation and lodgement experience

– STP payroll processing experience

– Excellent English written and verbal communication — must be able to brief Corey and Beth clearly

– High attention to detail and zero tolerance for errors in financial records

– Strong time management — ability to meet all ATO lodgement deadlines independently

– Comfortable working independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision



Desirable

– Degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, or Business

– Xero Certified Advisor status

– Prior experience managing a not-for-profit entity & books

– Familiarity with the Australian Small Business and hospitality / wellness industry

– Experience with booking systems, GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar CR
mbership systems



REPORTING & COMMUNICATION STRUCTURE



Day-to-Day Accountability ? Beth

Beth is your primary operational contact. She will manage task prioritisation, flag urgent items, relay

questions from the team, and ensure you have everything needed to do your job. Daily or near-daily

communication with Beth is expected.

Strategic Reporting ? Corey McKernan (Founder)

You report directly to Corey for all matters of financial significance — monthly reports, compliance

obligations, ATO issues, and anything requiring a strategic decision. Corey expects a monthly

financial briefing and ad-hoc escalation when required. He values directness, proactivity, and people

who surface problems before they become crises.

External Accountant Liaison ? Emandem

You will work alongside Mark at Emandem (external accountant) at EOFY, for any tax planning, and

for complex compliance matters. Your role is to keep the books clean enough that Mark's time is

spent on strategy, not cleaning up data.

title: Marketing Manager (100% Remote)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

This is a hands-on role for a strong writer and operator, not a high-level strategist or designer. Best suited for: 

- Strong at writing and execution

- Organized and consistent

- Comfortable using AI tools



Managed IT Services | Serving Construction Companies | Translate technology lingo into business risk and outcomes



WHO WE ARE

We are a growing MSP serving construction companies in the NYC market. Our clients rely on us to keep job sites running, prevent downtime, and protect their business from costly disruptions. We are looking for a Marketing Manager who can clearly communicate business risk, drive consistent content, and help generate inbound opportunities.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This role is responsible for owning and executing our marketing content engine — with a strong focus on:



Writing high-quality LinkedIn content

Translating technical IT services into real business impact

Maintaining consistent output

Using AI to improve speed and quality

Supporting lead generation through content



You should be someone who thinks in terms of business outcomes, not just marketing activity.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. High-Quality Content Creation (Primary Focus)

Write 3–4 high-quality LinkedIn posts per week

Tailor messaging specifically to:

Construction business owners

Office managers and operations teams



Translate IT topics into:

Downtime costs

Project delays

Financial and operational risk



Example: Instead of “cybersecurity protection,” you thinK “What happens when your team can’t access plans on a job site?”



2. Content Repurposing & Short-Form Video

Turn written content into 2–3 short-form videos weekly

Create simple, engaging videos using tools like Canva and CapCut

Focus on:

Strong hooks

Clear captions

Business-relevant messaging



3. AI-Driven Content Production

Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to:

Generate ideas

Draft and expand content

Increase output efficiency



Refine and edit AI outputs to ensure they are:

Natural

High-quality

Not generic



4. Marketing Calendar Ownership

Plan and maintain a 2–4 week rolling content calendar

Ensure all content is:

Scheduled

Delivered on time

Aligned with business priorities



5. Performance Awareness & Optimization

Focus on generating inbound interest (not just posting)

Track engagement trends (likes, comments, inbound messages)

Identify which topics resonate best with our audience

Adjust topics and messaging based on engagement to improve results



6. Lead Generation Support (Critical Outcome)

Create content that encourages:

Conversations

Inbound inquiries

Prospect interest

Align messaging with sales goals



REQUIREMENTS

Strong English writing with a natural, professional “American” tone in plain speak

Proven ability to write B2B content that is clear and persuasive

Ability to translate technical topics into business value

Experience using AI tools effectively (not just basic prompting)

Strong organizational skills and consistent execution

Ability to work independently and take ownership



Highly Preferred

Experience with MSPs, IT services, or B2B industries

Experience writing for non-technical audiences (construction, trades, SMBs)

Understanding of business risk, operations, financial impact messaging



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Consistent posting (3–4x/week) without delays

Clear improvement in content quality and messaging

Content that speaks directly to construction companies

Increasing engagement and inbound conversations

Minimal need for editing or rewriting

title: Video Editor specialised in meta ads
description:
Job Title: Part-Time Video Editor — Meta Ads 



About the Role:

We're looking for a talented part-time video editor to join the Lumelle team. Lumelle is a premium UK hair-protection brand selling satin-lined shower caps and hair accessories. We run paid social ads on Meta 
 & Instagram) and need a reliable, fast editor to turn our footage and briefs into polished, high-converting ads.

This starts as a part-time role (approximately 20 hours per week) with a clear path to full-time for the right person as our creative output scales.



The average video you will edit will be mainly AI generated videos put together with AI voiceovers, with some AI generated B-roll or many of the B-roll clips we currently have from our UGC creatives. We will provide all the videos and voiceovers, you'll be in charge of putting together and the editing of it.



Here's our meta ads library so you can view our current ads: 



(You will have to set to United Kingdom if it doesn't already do that)





How It Works

You won't need to source footage or come up with creative concepts. We handle all of that. You'll receive:



Raw footage and AI-generated video clips

A written script and edit brief

Brand guidelines and reference ads



Your job is to turn that into a finished, publish-ready ad. Fast, clean, and on-brand every time.



What You'll Be Editing



10–30 second hook clips for Meta TOF ads

30–60 second UGC-style ad edits

3–5 minute VSL (Video Sales Letter) edits

Recuts and resizes of existing ads into different formats (1:1, 4:5, 9:16)



What We're Looking For



Proven experience editing direct-response or performance marketing videos

Clean caption work — readable, well-timed, on-brand

Able to cut to pace — we use short punchy edits, one thought per cut

Takes direction well and delivers with minimal revisions

Reliable turnaround — we move fast and need someone who matches that energy

Communicates clearly and flags issues early



Brand Style

Soft, premium, feminine. Pastel pink palette. Quiet luxury — not flashy, not chaotic. You'll be given full brand guidelines and example ads before you start so you know exactly what good looks like.



Software

CapCut Pro or Premiere Pro preferred. Must be able to export to correct Meta ad specs.



Hours & Rate

Part-time: approximately 20 hours per week

Please state your hourly or monthly rate in your application



To Apply, Please Include:



2–3 examples of Meta ad edits or short-form video edits you've produced

Any VSL or long-form video work

Your availability and typical turnaround time per video

Your preferred rate

title: Looking for a part-time VA / private profile manager for a sensitive online presence
description:
I’m looking for someone warm, socially intelligent, discreet, and thoughtful to help manage and grow a sensitive personal online presence across multiple platforms.



This is not a typical social media VA role, and it is definitely not a spammy growth-hacking role. The goal is to build a presence that feels human, trustworthy, respectful, warm, and carefully positioned.



This role would suit someone who naturally understands tone, people, community dynamics, and how small details can affect trust.



You would help with multi-platform strategy, profile presentation, messaging, community research, and organizing leads/messages. A big part of the role is helping the profile show up consistently while still feeling authentic, calm, discreet, and not pushy.



Main tasks may include:



Researching
 groups, niche platforms, Instagram, and other possible channels

Understanding community culture and group dynamics before posting

Helping with profile positioning, image presentation, and overall trust signals

Drafting posts, captions, and messages for review

Organizing leads, messages, platforms, and follow-ups

Suggesting ways to increase visibility without sounding spammy, desperate, defensive, or overly salesy

Helping avoid unnecessary drama, especially in communities with politics, hostile comments, or sensitive dynamics

Knowing when something should be engaged with, ignored, softened, clarified, or escalated



You would not be expected to handle legal, medical, or highly sensitive conversations. You also would not reply to sensitive messages without approval. I care more about careful judgment than speed.



The ideal person is someone who is:



Warm, emotionally intelligent, and good with people

Discreet and comfortable with sensitive/private topics

Strong in written English

Calm under group politics or hostile comments

Proactive, but not reckless

Careful with tone and wording

Able to research online communities before engaging

Good at making profiles feel trustworthy and human

Organized enough to track leads, messages, platforms, and follow-ups

Thoughtful about how things may be perceived by different people



Experience with community management, client success, social media, online profiles, PR, Canva/graphics, or sensitive client-facing work is a plus.



The best fit is someone who can act almost like a thoughtful right hand: helping create controlled, consistent visibility while protecting the tone, reputation, and trust of the profile.

- Radical Candor (Direct & Transparent): No beating around the bush. We value efficient, clear, and straightforward communication. You are open, honest, and not afraid to give or receive direct feedback.



- High Velocity (Move Fast & Adapt): We are a young, fast-moving team. You thrive in a high-paced environment, pivot quickly when needed, and combine a sense of urgency with high execution power.



- Humble & Hungry (Continuous Growth): You bring positive energy. You are highly ambitious but leave your ego at the door. You are fiercely eager to learn, extremely coachable, and constantly looking to level up.





How to Apply
