We are seeking a highly motivated Junior Virtual Assistant to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone eager to learn, well-organized, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, sometimes chaotic environment. You’ll be working closely with the business owner and our current VA in the Philippines — often on a constant Teams call — to help keep the daily operations of our eCommerce business running smoothly.



Key Responsibilities:



Assisting with product listings across eCommerce platforms (Amazon, Etsy, eBay, Shopify).



Supporting customer service tasks (responding to inquiries, resolving issues politely).



Helping with bookkeeping basics, daily income/ads reports, and expense logging.



Creating or updating graphics and simple content in Canva.



Scheduling or posting basic content on social media platforms (FB, IG, TikTok).



Researching new products, suppliers, or tools to improve efficiency.



Organizing files, data, and creating structure in workflows.



Identifying improvements and suggesting new ways to streamline processes.



Requirements:



Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).



Ability to listen, talk, and work simultaneously during live calls.



Comfortable handling repetitive daily tasks with accuracy.



Proactive mindset — able to research and learn independently when needed.



Basic familiarity with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive).



Bonus skills (not required but preferred): bookkeeping tools, Canva, social media scheduling, e-commerce listing experience.



Perks of the Job:



Hands-on training provided for Amazon, Etsy, eBay, and ads reporting.



Opportunity to grow into higher-level responsibilities (ads management, campaign prep, workshop coordination).



Chance to work closely with a supportive team and integrate into daily operations — not just a “task-based” VA role.



Long-term opportunity, with potential for in-person meetups when the owner is in Manila.



How to Apply:

To apply for this position, please fill out the following Application Form.

AI-generated responses are not permitted — if detected, it will negatively affect your chances.







This is a great opportunity for someone starting out as a Virtual Assistant and eager to build a career in eCommerce. If you’re enthusiastic, reliable, and ready to bring structure to a growing business, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Experienced UX/UI Designer for E-Commerce Projects
description:
We are Nostalgic-Art (Germany-based), creating retro-themed products and selling globally via e-commerce (Amazon, B2B & B2C) plus a marketing website. These are all supported by a growing digital team of developers, designers, and web analytics specialists. We’ve also built strong partnerships with talented freelancers from the Philippines.



We’re looking for an experienced UX/UI Designer based in the Philippines to join us long-term. If you enjoy creating smooth, user-friendly experiences, love working with clean and structured design systems, and want to collaborate with an international and creative team, this could be a great fit.



What You’ll Do

- Design and improve e-commerce shops, landing pages, and other marketing interfaces.

- Follow and help improve our existing design system.

- Create reusable components, templates, and layouts that can scale.

- Use Figma, Notion, and MS Teams for daily collaboration.

- Take initiative, suggest UX improvements, and help solve usability issues.

- Make sure designs work well across all devices.

- Guide and support a junior UI/UX designer, helping them improve their skills and work.

- Confident using Figma and working with design systems.

- Good eye for layout, typography, spacing, and overall design.

- Comfortable working remotely, independently, and communicating clearly.

- Familiar with tools like Notion and Adobe Suite (nice to have).

- Interest in vintage or retro design is a plus, but not required.

- Fully remote

- Flexible hours

- Paid test project

- Long-term opportunity



Pay

- Hourly (include your rate in USD)

How to Apply - Please include the following in your application:

1. Short introduction about yourself and your motivation for this role.

2. Link to your portfolio, ideally with e-commerce or app-related work.

3. Details about your experience with Figma and design systems.

title: Part-Time Social Media Assistant & Video Editor
description:
Description:

We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Social Media Assistant & Video Editor to support our content operations. This is a part-time, monthly position based in the Philippines, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role over time.



In this role, you will be responsible for managing 2–3 social media accounts while producing a high volume of short-form video content. You will take long-form videos and break them down into multiple engaging clips for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.



Responsibilities:



Edit 10–20 short-form videos per day using CapCut

Cut and repurpose long-form content into multiple short clips

Add captions and subtitles using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

Post, schedule, and manage content across social media accounts

Write or refine captions for posts

Create slideshow posts occasionally

Maintain consistent posting and content flow

Ensure videos meet quality and brand standards while maintaining speed

Communicate with other employees through WhatsApp consistently



Requirements:



Decent experience with CapCut (required)

Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

Fast and reliable internet connection

Good understanding of short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

Ability to work efficiently and handle high-volume output

Decent fluency in English (written and basic communication)

Organized, consistent, and able to meet deadlines



This is a fixed part-time position with performance-based growth opportunities. We are looking for someone dependable who can handle both editing and social media responsibilities while maintaining a steady output of content.



*Any replies with ChatGPT/AI reponses will be ignored, thank you

title: Junior Collections Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Junior Collections Officer to join our finance team.



Key Responsibilities:

Develop compassionate and client-focused collections strategies to manage overdue payments effectively.

Proactively monitor accounts to identify and address overdue payments.

Work collaboratively with clients to establish manageable payment plans and resolve outstanding balances. Manage payment plans and ensure compliance with our terms.

Ensure all communications are handled with sensitivity and align with Bare’s values of empathy and transparency.

Maintain accurate records of collections activities and prepare detailed reports for management.

Stay up-to-date with relevant laws and regulations to ensure compliance with industry standards.

Collaborate with internal teams, including client support and finance, to resolve account discrepancies and improve processes.

Work with debt collectors to hand over non-responsive files

Work with our credit reporting agency partner to default non-responsive clients

Analyse data from Xero to identify trends.

Find effective ways to communicate with customers via
, letters, telephone and text

Find data trends of cohorts to prevent debts becoming bad in the first place



About You:

-Proven experience in phone support, collections management, credit control, or a similar role, ideally in a customer-centric industry.

-Exceptional communication and negotiation skills with a compassionate approach to client interactions.

-Excel/Google sheets user and able to automate tasks

-Worked with CRM tools like Hubspot

-Worked accounting systems like Xero

-Ability to analyze data and provide insights into collection trends and challenges.

-Familiarity with collections systems and financial software and credit check software and processes

-Knowledge of collections laws and regulations, with a commitment to ethical practices.

-A genuine desire to make a positive difference in the lives of clients, aligning with Bare’s mission and values.

-Australian Collection Experience is preferred but not required.



Why Work With Us?

-Be part of a purpose-driven organization that is reshaping the funeral industry.

-Competitive salary and benefits package.

-Opportunities for professional growth and career development.

-A supportive and inclusive workplace culture where empathy and innovation are valued.

-Involved in company culture building activities, flexible days leave and the opportunity to work completely remotely.



How to Apply:

If you are ready to bring your expertise to a meaningful and innovative organization, we’d love to hear from you! Submit your CV & Cover letter with your application.

At Bare Funeral Group, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Graphic Designer / Graphic Artist (apparel / fashion design)
description:
Graphic Designer / Graphic Artist



**Remote | Full-Time | US CST Schedule**



## About the Company



SDG Group is a global apparel design and production company based in Missouri. The company supports brands and retailers across the apparel process, from design and technical development to manufacturing, production, and delivery. Their work includes apparel programs, lifestyle apparel, brand development, and product execution for established brands, retailers, and emerging companies. 



Role Overview



We are looking for a Graphic Designer / Graphic Artist who can create strong print graphics, logo designs, and apparel-related visual assets. This role is ideal for someone with a good eye for brand identity, typography, layout, and production-ready artwork.



The main focus is not just making designs look good. The right person should understand how graphics translate onto apparel, merchandise, packaging, and other brand materials.



## Key Responsibilities



Create original **print graphics, logo designs, and visual concepts** for apparel and brand-related projects.



Develop clean, production-ready artwork for use on garments, labels, packaging, presentations, and marketing materials.



Support design concepts for lifestyle apparel, uniforms, merchandise, and branded product lines.



Prepare files with proper formatting, resolution, color setup, and technical accuracy for print or production.



Refine existing logos, graphics, and brand assets while keeping the design aligned with the client’s identity.



Create mockups and visual presentations to help communicate design direction clearly.



Work with internal teams to revise artwork based on feedback and production requirements.



Maintain organized design files, source files, and final exported assets.



Stay aware of apparel, fashion, typography, print, and branding trends.



## Must-Have Qualifications



At least **2+ years of experience** as a Graphic Designer, Graphic Artist, Apparel Graphic Designer, or similar role.



Strong experience creating **print graphics and logo designs**.



Good understanding of design fundamentals: typography, layout, composition, color, and brand consistency.



Experience preparing artwork for print or production.



Strong skills in **Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop**.



Able to follow creative direction and apply feedback quickly.



Strong attention to detail, especially with file setup, spelling, alignment, and design accuracy.



Available to work on a **US CST schedule**.



## Preferred Qualifications



Experience designing for apparel, fashion, uniforms, merchandise, or promotional products.



Experience with screen print, embroidery, heat transfer, sublimation, or other garment decoration methods.



Ability to create apparel mockups or tech-pack-ready graphic placements.



Experience working with international or US-based clients.



Familiarity with production limitations, fabric types, garment placement, and print sizing.





TO APPLY: PLEASE ANSWER THE QUESTIONS BELOW 



1. Do you have experience creating print graphics and logo designs for apparel, merchandise, uniforms, or physical products? Please briefly share what types of designs you created and where they were used.



2. Have you prepared final artwork files for print or production before? Please confirm what file types, color formats, sizing, or production specs you usually prepare.



3. What design tools do you use most confidently? Please rate your skill level in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop from 1–5, and explain what you usually use each tool for.



4. Can you share a portfolio with examples of logo design, print graphics, apparel graphics, or brand-related artwork?

   Please include only work you personally created or heavily contributed to. (please ensure it's viewable)



5. Are you available to work full-time or with strong overlap during US CST hours? Please confirm your preferred schedule, current work status, and earliest start date.

title: Legal Billing Assistant
description:
Job Type: Full-time



Working Hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time (U.S.), Monday through Friday





We are a busy U.S.-based family law firm seeking a Legal Billing Specialist to own our billing, trust accounting, and collections operations. This position requires strong organizational skills, excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to manage sensitive client billing conversations while partnering with attorneys to keep billing accurate and on schedule.

This role is best suited for someone who is highly detail-oriented, professional on the phone, and capable of managing multiple matters and deadlines in a fast-paced legal environment.

REQUIREMENTS (MANDATORY - NO EXCEPTIONS)

Applicants must meet ALL of the following:



Fluent spoken and written English with a clear American accent

Strong grammar and writing proficiency

Minimum 2 years of legal billing experience, preferably in family law or a similarly complex practice area

Strong understanding of IOLTA trust accounting rules and compliance requirements

Strong Microsoft Excel proficiency, including formulas, pivot tables, and reconciliation work (this will be tested)

Working knowledge of basic accounting and bookkeeping principles such as debits and credits, accounts receivable, and account reconciliation

Experience using legal practice management software such as MyCase, Clio, or Lawmatics

Proficiency managing WIP, invoicing, trust fund applications, and billing reports

Ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



Computer with at least 8GB RAM (16GB preferred)

Stable internet connection (minimum 100 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload) with backup internet access in case of outages

USB headset with clear microphone, since this role handles daily client calls

Dual monitor setup preferred for cross-referencing time entries, invoices, and reports

Quiet, distraction-free home office

Availability to work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time (U.S.)



Applicants who do not meet these requirements will not be considered.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Trust and Retainer Management



Monitor client trust balances daily and flag accounts below the minimum retainer threshold

Send timely replenishment requests and follow up to ensure funds are received before work continues

Apply trust funds correctly and maintain IOLTA compliance at all times

Maintain accurate records of all trust transactions and payment activity



Billing and Invoicing



Review and audit attorney and paralegal time entries for accuracy and completeness before billing

Generate pre-bills, final invoices, and monthly review letters

Ensure billing descriptions clearly communicate the value of work performed

Manage work-in-progress and coordinate with attorneys on billing cycles

Run billing reports and provide regular summaries to management



Collections and AR Management



Follow up on past-due balances in a professional and non-confrontational manner

Set up and monitor client payment plans and escalate accounts that are not progressing

Partner with attorneys on client calls when billing issues require legal explanation

Initiate disengagement processes when appropriate and directed

Maintain accurate accounts receivable records and prepare write-off requests for management approval



Client Communication



Handle a minimum of 10 client calls daily (collections, billing inquiries, new client setup)

Communicate clearly regarding balances, statements, and payment options

Respond promptly and professionally, de-escalating concerns when needed

Ensure alignment with the legal team on all billing communications



System and Process Support



Maintain and update client billing records in the firm's practice management software

Assist in identifying and implementing process improvements to billing workflows

Support onboarding of new clients by setting up billing profiles and retainer agreements



PREFERRED



Collections and payment plan management experience in a legal setting

Familiarity with U.S. family law billing practices, retainer structures, and court fee schedules

Your updated resume

A short written paragraph (3-5 sentences) explaining your relevant legal billing and trust accounting experience

 subject line or in the first sentence of your application so we know you read the full job post.

Applications that do not include all required materials will not be considered.
